pages/Logs.tsx:    // Details Formatting
pages/Logs.tsx:    // ===============================
pages/Logs.tsx:    const formatDetails = (details: string) => {
pages/Logs.tsx:        if (!details) return null;
pages/Logs.tsx:        
pages/Logs.tsx:        // Resolve common ID patterns
pages/Logs.tsx:        let processedDetails = details;
pages/Logs.tsx:        
pages/Logs.tsx:        // Look for UUID-like patterns that might be IDs we have in nameMap
pages/Logs.tsx:        const uuidPattern = /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/gi;
pages/Logs.tsx:        const matches = details.match(uuidPattern);
pages/Logs.tsx:        
pages/Logs.tsx:        if (matches) {
pages/Logs.tsx:            matches.forEach(id => {
pages/Logs.tsx:                const resolvedName = nameMap[id];
pages/Logs.tsx:                if (resolvedName) {
pages/Logs.tsx:                    // Simple replacement for direct matches
pages/Logs.tsx:                    processedDetails = processedDetails.replace(id, String(resolvedName));
pages/Logs.tsx:                }
pages/Logs.tsx:            });
pages/Logs.tsx:        }
pages/Logs.tsx:
pages/Logs.tsx:        // Special handling for Tier: cat_... or similar prefixed IDs if any
pages/Logs.tsx:        Object.entries(nameMap).forEach(([id, name]) => {
pages/Logs.tsx:            const resolvedName = String(name);
pages/Logs.tsx:            // Case-insensitive replacement for the ID
pages/Logs.tsx:            const escapedId = id.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
pages/Logs.tsx:            const regex = new RegExp(escapedId, 'gi');
pages/Logs.tsx:            if (regex.test(processedDetails)) {
pages/Logs.tsx:                processedDetails = processedDetails.replace(regex, resolvedName);
pages/Logs.tsx:            }
pages/Logs.tsx:        });
pages/Logs.tsx:
pages/Logs.tsx:        // Split by brackets to highlight modified fields
pages/Logs.tsx:        const parts = processedDetails.split(/(\[.*?\])/g);
pages/Logs.tsx:        
pages/Logs.tsx:        return parts.map((part, i) => {
pages/Logs.tsx:            if (part.startsWith('[') && part.endsWith(']')) {
pages/Logs.tsx:                return (
pages/Logs.tsx:                    <span key={i} className="font-mono text-[10px] bg-slate-100 text-indigo-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-100/30 mx-1 font-bold">
pages/Logs.tsx:                        {part.slice(1, -1)}
pages/Logs.tsx:                    </span>
pages/Logs.tsx:                );
pages/Logs.tsx:            }
pages/Logs.tsx:            return <span key={i}>{part}</span>;
pages/Logs.tsx:        });
pages/Logs.tsx:    };
